bibl.title: The Title(s) of Menander's Sikyonioi.
bibl.seg: Federico Favi, The Title(s) of Menander's Sikyonioi.
bibl.note: Gives a new interpretation of lines 246-247, suggesting that the plural title Σικυώνιοι should now be taken to mean "The (alleged) Sicyonians" (i.e. Stratophanes and Philumena).
